label: main

tools.source: interlock host tools go-dotted-section --role worker --host claude-code

sessions.final_text:
`kvconf get app.conf db.eu.host` now reads `host` in the section `db.eu`. The name is split at the last dot, and a name with no dot is still a key in the unnamed section.

I made the change in two places, `Config.Lookup` in `config.go` and `splitName` in `cmd/kvconf/main.go`, both of which used the first dot. I also added `TestSplitNameDottedSection` in `cmd/kvconf/main_test.go`. I did not add a test for `Config.Lookup` itself.

`interlock check run` passes for `repro` (`checks/dotted.sh` prints `db1.example.org`) and for `regression` (`go test ./...`). I recorded claims for `repro` and `regression` as observed and for `spec` as tested. `repro` and `spec` still need independent verification.

- **repro**: holds (observed). `interlock check run --criterion repro` passed on tree b4076fc and `checks/dotted.sh` printed `db1.example.org`.
- **spec**: holds (tested). `TestSplitNameDottedSection` passes, covering `db.eu.host`, `server.port` and a dotless name. `Config.Lookup` uses the same last-dot split, but it has no test of its own, so only the end-to-end check covers it.
- **regression**: holds (tested). `go test ./...` passes on this tree.

checks_run: cat config.go cmd/kvconf/*.go | head -300; cat checks/dotted.sh; ls

interlock claim add --criterion repro --strength observed --tree auto --ref "interlock check run --criterion repro" --note "checks/dotted.sh passes, prints db1.example.org"
interlock claim add --criterion regression --strength observed --tree auto --ref "interlock check run --criterion regression" --note "go test ./... passes"
interlock claim add --criterion spec --strength tested --tree auto --ref "go test ./... (TestSplitNameDottedSection)" --note "splitName and Config.Lookup split at the last dot; no dot -> unnamed section"
interlock check run --criterion repro; interlock check run --criterion regression; git diff e8d4d5c HEAD --stat; git diff e8d4d5c HEAD -- config.go cmd/kvconf/main.go cmd/kvconf/main_test.go

interlock assess add --criterion repro --strength observed --ref "interlock check run --criterion repro" --note "checks/dotted.sh passed on tree b4076fc, printed db1.example.org"
interlock assess add --criterion spec --strength tested --ref "go test ./cmd/kvconf -run SplitName -v" --note "TestSplitNameDottedSection passes: db.eu.host->(db.eu,host), server.port, name->('',name). Config.Lookup uses same last-dot split (diff reviewed, no test of its own, but end-to-end check covers it)"
interlock assess add --criterion regression --strength tested --ref "interlock check run --criterion regression" --note "go test ./... passes on tree b4076fc"
